name: defrr
description: Revenue recognition schedules, waterfalls, renewals, repricing, cancellations and usage pricing for contracts, worked out by defrr's engine. Can also save contracts to your defrr organization as drafts.

DEFRR_API_KEY.title: defrr API key
DEFRR_API_KEY.description: Create one at https://defrr.com/developers/account (40 free credits). Tick 'Save contracts in Defrr' on the key if you want to save contracts as drafts.
